lead.title: Argá Medtech completes enrollment of the paroxysmal AF cohort in COHERENT-AF, its pivotal trial of sine-wave pulsed field ablation
lead.deck: The Biopôle Lausanne-based medtech has enrolled 150 intention-to-treat patients at 27 sites in Europe and the US for the first cohort of its pivotal IDE study; the persistent AF cohort should be complete within two months, out of a planned total of 410 patients. Its CSE platform, a single reconfigurable catheter (circular, linear, focal) driven by a sine-burst generator, is aimed at FDA and CE mark filings: an independent company backed by Gilde, Earlybird and Advent entering the home stretch in a PFA market dominated by the majors.

milestone.title: Caristo's FAI-Score coronary inflammation metric validated in 19,110 patients in JAMA Cardiology
milestone.summary: CaRi-Heart, the Oxford spin-out's software, uses AI to measure inflammation around the coronary arteries on a routine coronary CT scan. In the ORFAN study published in JAMA Cardiology, 51% of major cardiovascular events and 42% of cardiovascular deaths occurred in patients with a low calcium score (< 100); a very high FAI-Score with a zero calcium score was associated with a 14.1-fold higher risk of cardiovascular death.
milestone.why: It is the clinical argument that was missing to move beyond plaque-based screening alone: flagging 'invisible-risk' patients on scans that are already performed, at no extra imaging cost. For a company already CE-marked and deployed in NHS hospitals, a study of this size strengthens the reimbursement case and sets up the next round.

deal.thesis: German fund Callisto Health leads the round (€23M post-money valuation) in a Czech startup that turns a consumer ECG chest strap into an AI arrhythmia-monitoring tool, already MDR-certified according to an investor. The thesis: a low-cost device, cleared outside Europe (India, UAE), going international before even dominating its home market and aiming to predict arrhythmias before they appear.

brefsEurope.title: Contract manufacturer Quasar Medical takes a minority stake in CathPrint and will co-develop printed-electronics catheters
brefsEurope.summary: The Swedish startup prints circuits and electrodes directly onto catheter shafts instead of threading wires one by one: assembling a 10-electrode catheter would drop from 1.5-2 hours to 10 minutes, with costs cut by about 67% in one cited case. CathPrint stays independent and gains access to the CDMO's international customer base.

brefsEurope.title: Kardi AI raises €5.3M Series A led by Callisto Health
brefsEurope.summary: The Czech startup (connected ECG chest strap + AI arrhythmia analysis) is joined by the corporate venture programmes of Česká spořitelna and Slovenská sporiteľňa; the funds will finance expansion into Germany, India, the UAE and Southeast Asia, and predictive models of arrhythmia risk.

brefsEurope.title: Swiss dental medtech vVARDIS plans a NYSE listing to raise more than $200M
brefsEurope.summary: The company, which sells Curodont (peptides that halt early cavities and repair enamel without drilling or anaesthesia), is targeting a multi-billion-dollar valuation; its H1 2026 revenue more than tripled to $28.5M, with a net loss of $27.8M.

brefsEurope.title: Colospan signs its first European distribution deal for CG-100, its colorectal anastomosis protection device
brefsEurope.summary: Distributor Hospital Line gains exclusive rights in Cyprus and Greece for this CE-marked intraluminal bypass, which protects bowel joins after colorectal surgery; in the US, the device holds Breakthrough designation and remains in an IDE trial.

brefsEurope.title: Seven Swiss start-ups, including Skaaltec and dEEGtal Insights, will exhibit at MEDICA 2026
brefsEurope.summary: Skaaltec will show Smart VNS, a portable non-invasive vagus nerve stimulation wearable for post-stroke rehabilitation, and dEEGtal Insights an AI that interprets EEG for epilepsy diagnosis, at the Düsseldorf fair on November 16-19.

brefsIntl.title: Abbott wins simultaneous CE mark and FDA approval for UltiSynq, a defibrillation lead compatible with conduction system pacing
brefsIntl.summary: The first lead combining physiological pacing (CSP) and defibrillation, backed by the ASCEND CSP trial in 205 patients (97.5% free of major complications at 3 months). A comparable showing that physiological pacing is becoming the battleground of the cardiac rhythm majors.

brefsIntl.title: J&J Innovation (JJDC) backs Francis Medical to pursue a prostate cancer indication for its water vapour ablation
brefsIntl.summary: Undisclosed amount; the funds support a future PMA filing for Vanquish, after VAPOR 2 data showing elimination of targeted disease in 91% of the first 110 patients biopsied at six months.

brefsIntl.title: EnVision Endoscopy raises $11.5M Series A led by Puma Venture Capital
brefsIntl.summary: Its SimpleStitch endoscopic suturing system, compatible with standard flexible endoscopes and FDA-cleared in 2025, has passed its first 50 patient procedures.

word.definition: The FDA authorisation that allows a not-yet-authorised medical device to be used in US patients within a clinical trial, to collect the safety and effectiveness data required before market entry.

parts.label: Investigational plan
parts.role: the protocol and preclinical data submitted to the FDA

parts.label: Ethics committee (IRB)
parts.role: each site's local green light and patient consent

parts.label: 'Investigational use only' labelling
parts.role: the device stays restricted to the trial, tracked and monitored

how.t: For a significant-risk device, the company submits its investigational plan and bench and preclinical data to the FDA.
A first trial in a few dozen patients checks safety and fine-tunes the technique.
The pivotal trial, in hundreds of patients, generates the data that will feed the PMA or De Novo submission.

word.why: For a European medtech, the IDE is the gateway to the world's largest market and a valuation milestone: securing the IDE, then completing enrollment of a pivotal study, sharply reduces regulatory risk and often precedes the round that will fund the US launch. Many startups that are CE-marked in Europe raise specifically for their IDE.
